data.one_liner: Execute code after the first layout of your widget has been performed.
data.what_it_does: Brings functionality to execute code after the first layout of a widget has been completed, i.e., after the first frame has been displayed. It provides a mixin that allows developers to implement an afterFirstLayout method.
use_when: You need to display a dialog or bottom sheet immediately when a screen appears
You need to query widget dimensions or layout metrics right after the first frame
avoid_when: You can perform the initialization safely inside initState or standard lifecycle hooks
You are managing complex global application states
strengths: Prevents crashes caused by triggering layout-dependent code in initState
Automatically checks if the widget is mounted before executing the callback
weaknesses: Limited to a single specific lifecycle utility scope
May encourage imperative patterns when declarative approaches could work
